Vezehu mishkal achad asar sammaneha. nataf. ushechelet. vechelbena. ulevona. mikkol echad mishkal shivim mane. vehammane mea dinarin. umor. uketzia. veshibbolet nerd. vecharkom. mikkol echad shishsha asar mane. kosht shenem asar mane. kinnamon tisha manim. killufa shelosha manim. mishkal hakkol shelosh meot veshishshim ushemona mane. shechukin hakkol hadek. mosifin lah rova hakkav melach sedomit. vechippat hayyarden umaale ashan kol shehu. umaktir mimmenna bechol yom al mizbach hazzahav mane. shelosh meot veshishshim vachamishsha mane keneged yemot hachamma. vehashshelosha manim hannisharim shochek otam erev yom hakkippurim dakka min haddakka ad shemmotzi mimmenna male chafnav lehaketir beyom hakkippurim. vehashshear hu motar hakketoret sheamarnu bishkalim:
Nataf haamur battora hu atze hakketaf sheyyotze mehen hatztzori. vehashshechelet hi hatztzipporen shennotnin otah bene haadam bemugmarot. vehachelbena kemo devash shachor verecho kashe vehu seraf ilanot beare yavan. vezehu shemot hassammanim belashon aravi. ud belasan veatzfar tiv. umia. ulechan. umuseki. uketzia. vesanbeli alnatorin. vezaafran. vekosht. veud [hayyardi]. vekassar selicha. veinbar:
Ketzad mefattemin et hakketoret. mevi tisha kabbin borit karshina veshaf bah et hatztzipporen veachar kach shore et hatztzipporen beechad veesrim kav shel yen kafrisin o yayin lavan yashan chazak beyoter. veachar kach shochek kol echad min hassammanim bifne atzmo hadek. ucheshehu shochek omer hadek hetev hadek hetev kol zeman sheshshochek umearev hakkol:
Vechol maaseha bakkodesh betoch haazara umishshel hakkodesh. vehamefattem et hakketoret min hachullin o bichli shel chullin pesula:
Paamayim bashshana hayu machazirin oto lammachteshet. bimot hachamma hayu mefazzerim otah kede shello titappesh. uvimot haggeshamim tzovrin otah kede shello yafug rechah:
Natan letochah devash kol shehu pesalah. chisser echad missammaneha chayyav mita shehare naaset ketoret zara. pittemah meat meat bematkuntah keshera afillu pittem peras beshacharit uferas ben haarbayim:
Haose ketoret meachad asar sammanin ellu lefi mishkalot ellu kede lehariach bah af al pi shello heriach chayyav karet al asiyyatah im asa mezid. uveshogeg mevi chattat kevua. af al pi shello asa hammishkal kullo ella chetzyo o shelisho. hoil veasa lefi mishkalot ellu chayyav karet. shenneemar <small>(Shemot 30 37)</small> "bematkuntah lo taasu lachem" <small>(Shemot 30 38)</small> "ish asher yaase chamoha lehariach bah venichrat meammav":
Asaah lehitlammed bah o lemasrah latztzibbur patur. heriach bah velo asaah eno chayyav karet ella dino kedin kol hannehene min hahekdesh. lo chiyyeva tora karet ella laose bematkuntah lehariach bah:
Mizbach hazzahav shebbahechol alav maktirin hakketoret bechol yom. veen makrivin alav davar acher. veim hiktir alav ketoret acheret sheenah kazo. o shehiktir alav ketoret kazo shehitnaddev otah yachid o rabbim. o hikriv alav karban. o hissich nesech. loke shenneemar <small>(Shemot 30 9)</small> "lo taalu alav ketoret zara veola umincha" vegomer:
Beet shemmolichin et haaron mimmakom lemakom en molichin oto lo al habbehema velo al haagalot ella mitzva lenatlo al hakkatef. ulefi sheshshachach david unesao al haagala nifratz peretz beuzza. ella mitzva lenaso al hakkatef shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 7 9)</small> "ki avodat hakkodesh alehem bakkatef yissau":
Keshennosim oto al hakkatef nosin panim keneged panim vaachorehem lachutz ufenehem lefanim. venizharim shello yishshamtu habbaddim min hattabbaot. shehammesir echad min habbaddim min hattabbaot loke. shenneemar <small>(Shemot 25 15)</small> "betabbeot haaron yihyu habbaddim lo yasuru mimmennu":

Zera levi kullo muvdal laavodat hammikdash shenneemar <small>(Devarim 10 8)</small> "baet hahi hivdil Adonai et shevet hallevi". umitzvat ase lihyot haleviyyim penuyin umuchanin laavodat hammikdash ben ratzu ben shello ratzu shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 18 23)</small> "veavad hallevi hu et avodat ohel moed". uven levi shekkibbel alav kol mitzvot leviyya chutz middavar echad en mekabbelin oto ad sheyyekabbel et kullan:

Avoda shellahen hi sheyyihyu shomrin et hammikdash. veyihyu mehen shoarin liftoach shaare hammikdash ulehagif daltotav. veyihyu mehen meshorrin leshorer al hakkarban bechol yom. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 18 7)</small> "vesheret beshem Adonai elohav kechol echav haleviyyim". e zehu sherut shehu beshem Adonai heve omer zo shira. umatay omer shira al kol olot hatztzibbur hachova veal shalme atzeret beet nissuch hayyayin. aval olot nedava shemmakrivin hatztzibbur lekayitz lammizbeach. vechen hannesachin habbain bifne atzman. en omrin alehen shira:

Levi haonen muttar laavod uleshorer. veen pochatin mishshenem asar leviyyim omdim al hadduchan bechol yom lomar shira al hakkarban umosifin ad leolam veen omrin shira ella bappe belo keli sheikkar hashshira shehi avodatam bappe. vaacherim hayu omdim sham menaggenin bichle shir. mehen leviyyim umehen yisreelim meyuchasin hammassiin lichhunna. sheen ole al hadduchan ella meyuchas. veen ellu hameshorrim al pi hakkelim olin leminyan hashshenem asar:

Uvamme hem menaggenin. binvalim vachalilim vechinnorot vachatzotzrot vehatztziltzal. veen pochatin mishshene nevalim velo mosifin al shishsha. veen pochatin mishshene chalilim velo mosifin al shenem asar. veen pochatin mishshete chatzotzrot velo mosifin al esrim umea. veen pochatin mittisha kinnorot umosifin ad leolam. vehatztziltzal echad bilvad:

Bime hammoadot kullam uverashe chodashim hayu hakkohanim tokim bachatzotzrot bishat hakkarban vehaleviyyim omrin shira shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 10 10)</small> "uveyom simchatchem uvemoadechem uverashe chadshechem utekatem bachatzotzrot". hachatzotzra hayta naaset min eshet shel kesef. asa otah min haggerutaot shel kesef keshera. mishshear mine mattachot pesula. vehachalilin shehayu menaggenin bahen haya abbuv shellahen shel kane. mippene shekkolo arev. velo haya mechallek ella beabbuv yechidi mippene shehu mechallek yafe:

Bishnem asar yom bashshana hechalil makke lifne hammizbeach. bishchitat pesach rishon. uvishchitat pesach sheni. uveyom tov harishon shel pesach. uvayyom harishon shel atzeret. uvishmona yeme hechag. vechalil ze doche shabbat mippene shehu chalil shel karban vechalil shel karban avoda hi vedocha et hashshabbat:

En ben levi nichnas laazara laavodato ad sheyyelammeduhu chamesh shanim techilla. shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 8 24)</small> "zot asher lalviyyim mibben chamesh veesrim shana" vechatuv echad omer <small>(Bamidbar 4 3)</small> "mibben sheloshim shana". ha ketzad. chamesh lilmod. veeno nichnas laavoda ad sheyyagdil veyihye <small>(Bamidbar 4 19)</small> <small>(Bamidbar 4 49)</small> ish shenneemar "ish ish al avodato":

Ze shenneemar battora balviyyim <small>(Bamidbar 8 25)</small> "umibben chamishshim shana yashuv mitztzeva haavoda" eno ella bizman shehayu nosin hammikdash mimmakom lemakom. veeno mitzva noheget ledorot. aval ledorot en hallevi nifsal beshanim velo bemumin ella bekol sheyyitkalkel kolo merov hazzikna yippasel laavodato bammikdash. veyerae li sheeno nifsal ella lomar shira aval yihye min hashshoarim:

Shemuel haroe vedavid hammelech chilleku haleviyyim learbaa veesrim mishmarot. veoved mishmar bechol shabbat. vechol anshe mishmar mechallek otam rosh hammishmar levatte avot. vechol yom mime hashshabbat ovdim bo anashim yeduim. verashe haavot mechallekin ellu haovdim bayyom shellahen ish ish al avodato. vechol haleviyyim muzharin al avodat hammizbeach shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 18 3)</small> "ach el kele hakkodesh veel hammizbeach lo yikravu velo yamutu" lo yikravu laavoda aval ligga muttarin:

Ucheshem shehaleviyyim muzharin shello laavod avodat hakkohanim. kach hakkohanim muzharin shello laavod avodat haleviyyim shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 18 3)</small> "gam hem" <small>(Bamidbar 18 3)</small> "gam attem". vechen haleviyyim atzmam muzharim shello yaase echad melechet chavero. shello yesayyea hameshorer lashshoer velo hashshoer lamshorer shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 4 19)</small> "ish ish al avodato veel massao":

Leviyyim sheavdu avodat hakkohanim o shessiyyea levi bimlacha sheenah melachto chayyavin mita bide shamayim shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 18 3)</small> "velo yamutu". aval kohen sheavad avodat levi eno bemita ella belo taase:

Hakkohannim huvdelu mikkelal haleviyyim laavodat hakkarbanot shenneemar <small>(divrei hayamim 1 23 13)</small> "vayyibbadel aharon lehakedisho kodesh kadashim". umitzvat ase hi lehavedil hakkohanim ulekaddesham velahachinam lekarban shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 21 8)</small> "vekiddashto ki et lechem elohecha hu makriv":
Vetzarich kol adam miyyisrael linhog bahen kavod harebe ulehakdim otam lechol davar shebbikdushsha. liftoach battora rishon. ulevarech rishon. velittol mana yafa rishon:
Moshe rabbenu chillek hakkohanim lishmone mishmarot. arbaa meelazar. vearbaa meitamar. vechen hayu ad shemuel hannavi. uvime shemuel chillekam hu vedavid hammelech learbaa veesrim mishmar. veal kol mishmar umishmar rosh echad memunne. veolin lirushalayim laavoda mishmar lechol shabbat. umiyyom hashshabbat leyom hashshabbat hen mitchallefin mishmar yotze vehaacher shehu acharav nichnas. ad sheyyigmeru vechozrin chalila:
Umitzvat ase lihyot kol hammishmarot shavim bargalim. vechol sheyyavo min hakkohanim baregel veratza laavod oved vecholek immahem. veen omrin lo lech ad sheyyaggia mishmarcha shenneemar <small>(Devarim 18 6)</small> "vechi yavo hallevi meachad shearecha" vegomer:
Bamme devarim amurim bekarbenot hargalim uvechilluk lechem happanim uvechilluk shete hallechem shel atzeret. aval nedarim unedavot utemidin en makrivin otan ella mishmar shezzemanno kavua vaafillu baregel. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 18 8)</small> "chelek kechelek yochelu levad mimkarav al haavot". kelomar chelek kechelek yochlu bekarbenot hatztzibbur. veen chelek kechelek bishar haddevarim shekkevar chalku otam haavot ukevaum kol mishmar umishmar beshabbatto:
Vechen avodat lechem happanim bammishmar shezzemanno kavua. aval avodat shete hallechem bechol hammishmarot. uminnayin sheeno medabber ella bargalim shenneemar <small>(Devarim 18 6)</small> "meachad shearecha mikkol yisrael" beshaa shekkol yisrael bain beshaar echad. uminnayin sheeno medabber ella bakkohanim shenneemar <small>(Devarim 18 8)</small> "chelek kechelek yochelu". veen sham mattanot bammikdash leheachel ella lakkohanim bilvad:
Vechen kohen shehaya lo karban hare ze ba lammikdash umakrivo bechol yom sheyyirtze shenneemar <small>(Devarim 18 6)</small> "uva bechol avvat nafsho" <small>(Devarim 18 7)</small> "vesheret". vaafillu chattato vaashamo hu makriv umechapper al yede atzmo vehaor shel karbano vaachilato shello. veim ratza litten et karbano lechol kohen sheyyirtze lehakerivo noten. veor hakkarban vaavodato leoto hakkohen bilvad shennatan lo:
Haya hakkohen baal hakkarban baal mum noten karbano leanshe mishmar vehaor shellahem. haya zaken o chole sheyyachol laavod al yede haddechak noten karbano lechol kohen sheyyirtze vehaor vehaavoda leanshe mishmar. veim eno yachol laavod kelal hare hakkarban kullo leanshe mishmar:
Haya tame bekarbenot hatztzibbur vechol hakkohanim temeim notno levaale mumin tehorim shebbeoto mishmar. veoro vaavodato leanshe mishmar hattemeim:
Haya hakkarban shel kohen gadol vehaya onen notno lechol kohen sheyyirtze veoro vaavodato leanshe mishmar. kevan shekkohen gadol haonen rauy laavoda kemo sheyyitbaer hare ze ose shaliach lekarbano:
Kol rosh mishmar umishmar mechallek mishmaro levatte avot. ad sheyyihye kol bet av vaanashav oved beyom echad mimot hashshabbat. vehaacher beyom shel acharav. vehaacher beyom shel acharav. ulechol bet av veav rosh echad memunne alav:
Umemannin kohen gadol hu rosh lechol hakkohanim. umoshchin oto beshemen hammishcha. umalbishin oto bigde kehunna gedola shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 21 10)</small> "vehakkohen haggadol meechav asher yutzak" vegomer. veim en sham shemen hammishcha merabbin oto bevigde kehunna gedola bilvad shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 21 10)</small> "asher yutzak al rosho shemen hammishcha umille et yado lilbosh et habbegadim". keshem shemmitrabbe beshemen hammishcha kach mitrabbe bivgadim:
Ketzad merabbin oto bivgadim. lovesh shemona begadim ufoshtan vechozer velovshan lemachar shivat yamim yom achar yom shenneemar <small>(Shemot 29 30)</small> "shivat yamim yilbasham hakkohen tachtav mibbanav". ucheshem sheribbuy begadim shiva kach meshicha beshemen shiva yom achar yom. veim avad kodem sheyyitrabbe bivgadim kol shiva o kodem sheyyimmashach kol shiva avodato keshera. hoil venitrabba o nimshach paam achat naasa kohen gadol lechol davar:
En ben kohen mashuach beshemen hammishcha limrubbe begadim ella par shemmevi kohen hammashiach im shagag beechad min hammitzvot shechayyav alehen chattat shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 4 3)</small> "im hakkohen hammashiach yecheta" vegomer. aval lishar haddevarim shavim hem:
En maamidin kohen gadol ella bet din shel echad veshivim. veen moshchin oto ella bayyom shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 6 13)</small> "beyom himmashach oto". vechen im nitrabba bivgadim bilvad en merabbin oto ella bayyom. veen memannin shene kohanim gedolim keachat:
Memannin kohen echad yihye lechohen gadol kemo hammishne lammelech vehu hannikra segan. vehu hannikra memunne veyihye omed limin kohen gadol tamid veze kavod hu lo. vechol hakkohanim mittachat yad hassegan:
Veod memannin kattikolin lihyot lassegan kemo hassegan lechohen gadol. veen pochatin mishshenayim. umemannim amarkalin en pachot mishshiva. umaftechot haazara beyadam ratza haechad liftoach eno yachol ad sheyyitkannesu kol haamarkolin veyiftechu:
Umemannin gizbarin mittachat yede haamarkolin. veen pochatin mishshelosha gizbarin. vehaggizbarin hem sheggovin kol hahekdeshot. ufodin et hannifde mehen umotziin otan bidvarim haruyin lahen lehotzian:
Kohen haggadol hammashuach kodem limrubbe begadim. umerubbe begadim haomed lesharet kodem lemashuach sheavar mechamat keri. vehaover mechamat keri kodem leover mechamat mum. vehaover mechamat mum kodem lechohen meshuach milchama. umeshuach milchama kodem lisgan. usegan kodem lekattikol. vekattikol kodem laamarkol. vaamarkol kodem legizbar. vegizbar kodem lerosh mishmar. verosh hammishmar kodem lerosh bet av. verosh bet av kodem lechohen hedyot mishshear hakkohanim. nimtzeu hakkohanim tamid shemone maalot zo lemala mizzo:
Kesheyyamut hammelech o kohen gadol o echad mishshear hamemunnim maamidin tachtav beno o harauy leyarsho. vechol hakkodem lenachala kodem lisrarot hammet. vehu sheyyihye memalle mekomo bechachma o beyira af al pi sheeno kemoto bechachma shenneemar bemelech <small>(Devarim 17 20)</small> "hu uvanav bekerev yisrael". melammed shehammalchut yerushsha. vehu haddin lechol serara shebbekerev yisrael shehazzoche lah zoche leatzmo ulezaro:
Meshuach milchama en beno mitmanne tachtav leolam ella hare hu kishar hakkohanim. im nimshach lammilchama nimshach veim lo nimshach lo nimshach. ucheshekkohen meshuach milchama meshammesh bammikdash meshammesh bearbaa kelim kishar kohanim. maalin misserara lisrara gedola mimmenna veen moridin oto lasserara shehi lematta mimmenna. shemmaalin bakkodesh velo moridin. veen moridin leolam misserara shebbekerev yisrael ella im sarach:
Vechohen gadol sheavar avera shechayyav aleha malkot malkin oto bevet din shel shelosha kishar mechuyyeve malkot vechozer ligdullato:

Kohen gadol tzarich sheyyihye gadol mikkol echav hakkohanim benoy bechoach beosher bechachma uvemare. en lo mamon kol hakkohanim notnin lo mishshellahen kol echad lefi ashro ad sheyyaashir yoter meashir shebbechullan:
Veen echad mikkol ellu meakkev ella kol ze lemitzva aval im nitrabba mikkol makom nitrabba:
Vechayyav kohen gadol linhog kavod beatzmo. velo yakel beatzmo im shear haam velo yiru oto arum lo bevet hammerchatz velo bevet hakkisse velo keshemmistapper shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 21 10)</small> "hakkohen haggadol meechav" melammed shennohagin bo gedulla yetera. ratza hu sheyyirchatzu acherim immo harshut beyado:
Lo yikkanes levet hammishte velo lisudda shel rabbim afillu hem shel mitzva. aval holech hu im ratza levet haavel. ucheshehu holech eno holech beirbuveya im shear hakkohanim. ella mesabbevin oto hakkohanim vecholkin lo kavod. vehassegan mematztzeo beno leven haam. vehassegan umashuach sheavar mimino. verosh bet av vehaavelim vechol haam missemolo. veomer laavelim tenuchamu. vehen mechabbedin oto kefi kochan:
Met lo met eno yotze acharav. veeno yotze mippetach beto o min hammikdash. vechol haam baim lenachamo leveto. vehu omed beshura usegan mimino verosh bet av vechol haam missemolo. veomrim lo anu kapparatcha vehu omer lahem titbarchu min hashshamayim:
Ucheshemmavrin oto kol haam mesubbin al haaretz vehu mesev al hassafsal. veeno korea al meto kishar hakkohanim shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 21 10)</small> "uvegadav lo yifrom". veim kara loke. aval korea hu millematta keneged raglav. veeno marbe pera leolam shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 21 10)</small> "et rosho lo yifra" vaafillu beet shello yikkanes lammikdash. ella mesapper meerev shabbat leerev shabbat. veeno mesapper betaar ella bezug rosh saara zo beikkar zo ad sheyyerae keillu hu tzamach keachat shenneemar <small>(Yechezkel 44 20)</small> "rosham lo yegallechu ufera lo yeshallechu kasom yichsemu et rashehen": 
Uvayit yihye lo muchan bammikdash vehu hannikra lishkat kohen gadol. vetifarto uchevodo sheyyihye yoshev bammikdash kol hayyom. velo yetze ella leveto bilvad ballayla o shaa o shetayim bayyom. veyihye beto birushalayim veeno zaz mishsham:
Kohen gadol dan vedanin oto umeidin alav. veen danin oto dine nefashot ella bevet din haggadol bilvad shenneemar <small>(Shemot 18 22)</small> "kol haddavar haggadol yaviu elecha":
Haya yodea edut eno chayyav lehaid vaafillu bevet din haggadol shezze eno kavod lo sheyyelech veyaid. veim hayta edut lemelech yisrael hare ze holech bevet din haggadol umeid lo:
Uchevar bearnu besefer kedushsha shehu asur bealmana umetzuvve al habbetula. veeno nose shete nashim veim nasa shetayim eno yachol laavod beyom hatztzom ad sheyyegaresh leachat. vecholetz vecholtzim leishto. umeyabbemin et ishto. veim geresh ishsha mutteret lehinnase lishar haam:
Bizman shekkohen gadol nichnas lahechol lehishtachavot shelosha ochazin bo. echad bimino veechad bismolo veechad baavanim tovot shebbaefod meachorav. veyikkanes lahechol veyishtachave. vechevan sheyyishma hassegan kol raglav shel kohen gadol shehu yotze magbiah lo et happarochet. veachar sheyyetze yikkansu echav hakkohanim veyishtachavu veyetzu:
Bechol yom sheyyirtze lehaketir hakketoret maktir venotel chelek barosh bekadshe hammikdash kullan. ketzad. kesheyyirtze omer zo hachattat shelli veze haasham shelli. veeno oved befayis. ella kol et sheyyirtze lehakeriv makriv kol ma sheyyirtze. vahare hu bekadshe haggevul kishar hakkohanim:
Bizman sherotze kohen gadol lehakeriv haya ole bakkevesh vehassegan mimino. higgia lemachatzit hakkevesh achaz hassegan bimino veheelahu. vehoshit lo hakkohen shehu molich et rosh haola haevarim shebbeyado vesomech alehen vezorkan laesh:
Vechach hayu moshitin lo shear haevarim. kol echad veechad noten haevarim shebbeyado larishon. veharishon noten lechohen gadol vehu somech vezorek laesh. veim ratza lismoch bilvad veyihye [kohen] acher zorek laesh ose. veen sham semicha al haevarim ella lechohen gadol bilvad mippene kevodo. aval kol hassemichot al baale chayyim hem:
Kesheyyigdal hakkohen veyease ish hare hu kasher laavoda. aval echav hakkohanim lo hayu menichin oto laavod bammikdash ad sheyyihye ben esrim shana. veeno nichnas laazara laavoda techilla ella beshaa shehaleviyyim omrim shira:
En hakkohen oved techilla vechen kohen gadol eno oved techilla ad sheyyavi asirit haefa mishshello veoved beyado shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 6 13)</small> "ze karban aharon uvanav asher yakrivu laAdonai beyom himmashach oto". veim avad kodem sheyyavi asirit haefa vechen kohen gadol sheavad bichhunna gedola kodem sheyyavi asirit haefa avodato keshera:
Kohen shello avad adayin miyyamav shemminnuhu kohen gadol hare ze mevi asirit haefa veovdah beyado battechilla kishar chinnuch kol kohen hedyot veachar kach makriv asirit haefa sheniyya shehi chinnuch kohen gadol. veachar kach makriv asirit haefa shelishit shehi chavite kohen gadol shemmakriv bechol yom kemo sheyyitbaer umaase shelashtan shave hu:

I efshar sheyyihye karbano shel adam karev vehu eno omed al gabbav. vekarbenot hatztzibbur hen karban shel kol yisrael vei efshar sheyyihyu yisrael kullan omdin baazara bishat karban. lefichach tikkenu neviim harishonim sheyyivreru miyyisrael kesherim viree chet veyihyu sheluche kol yisrael laamod al hakkarbanot vehem hannikraim anshe maamad. vechilleku otam 24 maamadot keminyan mishmerot kehunna uleviyya. veal kol maamad umaamad echad mehen memunne al kullam vehu nikra rosh hammaamad:
Bechol shabbat veshabbat mitkabbetzin anshe maamad shel otah shabbat. mi shehaya mehen birushalayim o karov lah nichnasin lammikdash im mishmar kehunna uleviyya shel otah shabbat. veharchokim shebbeoto maamad kevan shehiggia maamad shellahen hen mitkabbetzin levet hakkeneset shebbimkoman:
Uma hen osin ellu hammitkabbetzin ben birushalayim ben bevatte kenesiyyot. mitannin besheni bashshabbat shellahen. uvishlishi uvirvii uvachamishi. aval beerev shabbat lo hayu mitannin mippene kevod shabbat uveechad beshabbat enam mitannim kede shello yetzu meoneg shabbat letzom:
Uvechol yom veyom mishshabbat shehaya maamadan mitpallelin arba tefillot shacharit umincha uneila veod mosifin tefilla acheret ben shacharit umincha vehi yetera lahen. venosin kappehen hakkohanim bamaamad shalosh peamim bechol yom beshacharit uvattefilla zo hayetera uvinila. vekorin besefer tora shelosha anashim shete peamim bechol yom beshacharit uvattefilla hashsheniyya shemmosifin aval bemincha lo hayu korin besefer tora ella al pe kekorin et shema. velo hayu mitkabbetzin litfillat mincha beerev shabbat mippene shehen terudin leshabbat:
Vekibbutzan lechol tefilla mearba tefillot ellu vaamidatan sham litfilla velitchinna ulevakkasha velikrot battora nikra maamad:
Uvamme hayu korin bemaase bereshit. bayyom harishon korin bereshit vihi rakia. bashsheni yehi rakia veyikkavu. bishlishi yikkavu vihi meorot. birvii <small>(Bereshit 1 14)</small> "yehi meorot" <small>(Bereshit 1 20)</small> "veyishretzu". bachamishi yishretzu <small>(Bereshit 1 24)</small> "vetotze haaretz". beshishshi totze haaretz <small>(Bereshit 2 1)</small> "vaychullu": 
Parasha gedola korin otah bishnayim uketanna kore otah echad. ushete parashiyyot shekkorin shacharit hem shechozrin vekorin otan bitfilla hashsheniyya bassefer. vechozrin vekorin otan bammincha al pe:
Shemonat yeme chanukka lo hayu anshe maamad osin maamad beshacharit. vechol yom sheyyesh bo karban musaf lo haya bo maamad lo bitfilla sheniyya shellahem velo bammincha. ella beshacharit uvinila bilvad. vechol yom shehaya bo karban haetzim lo haya bo maamad binila ella beshacharit uvitfilla sheniyya uvemincha:
Umahu karban haetzim. zeman kavua haya lemishpachot mishpachot latzet layarim lehavi etzim lammaaracha. veyom sheyyaggia livne mishpacha zo lehavi haetzim hayu makrivin olot nedava vezehu karban haetzim vehaya lahem kemo yom tov. vaasurin bo behesped uvetaanit uvaasiyyat melacha vedavar ze minhag:
Afillu yachid shehitnaddev etzim o gezarim bammaaracha asur beoto hayyom behesped uvetaanit uvaasiyyat melacha vedavar ze minhag:
Anshe maamad asurin millesapper umillechabbes kol shabbat shellahen. uvachamishi muttarin mippene kevod hashshabbat. umippene ma asru alehem lesapper ulechabbes kede shello yikkansu lemaamadam keshehem menuvvalin. ella yesapperu vichabbesu mikkodem:

Chamisha asar memunnin hayu bammikdash vechen memannim leolam al kol davar mechamishsha asar devarim ellu memunne echad. veellu hen (1) al hazzemannim (2) al neilat shearim (3) al hashshomrim (4) al hameshorrim (5) al hatztziltzal im shear kele shir (6) al happeyasot (7) al hakkanim (8) al hachotamot (9) al hannesachim (10) al hacholin (11) al hammayim (12) al maase lechem happanim (13) al maase hakketoret (14) al maase happarochet (15) al maase bigde kehunna:

Kol echad veechad mimmemunnim ellu tachat yado anashim harebe kede lehachin hammelacha shehu memunne aleha. ze sheal hazzemannim hu vaanashav meshammerim et hazzemannim. kevan sheyyaggia et hakkarban machriz hu o echad meanashav birshuto veomer imdu kohanim laavoda uleviyyim ladduchan veyisrael lammaamad vechevan sheyyishma kolo yavo kol echad limlachto:

Ze sheal neilat shearim al piv noalin veal piv potchin veen hattokin tokin bechol yom liftichat hashshearim ella birshuto. uvechol yom tokin bammikdash shalosh tekiot liftichat hashshearim tekia terua utekia:
Ze sheal hashshomrim hu ish har habbayit shemmesabbev al haleviyyim bechol layla vechol mi sheyyashen al mishmaro malke oto bemaklo vesoref et kesuto:

Ze sheal hameshorrim hu borer bechol yom hameshorrim sheomdim al hadduchan lomar shira bappe. veal piv tokin al hakkarbanot. en pochatin bammikdash meachat veesrim tekia bechol yom. shalosh liftichat shearim. vetesha letamid shel shachar. vetesha letamid shel ben haarbayim. veyom sheyyesh bo karban musaf mosifin tesha al karban musaf. veim chal rosh chodesh o yom tov lihyot beshabbat o shechal rosh hashshana lihyot beshabbat sheyyesh sham shelosha musafin en tokin lechol musaf umusaf bifne atzmo ella tokin tesha bilvad lechol hammusafin:

Beerev shabbat mosifin shesh. shalosh lehavetil et haam min hammelacha veshalosh lehavedil ben kodesh lechol. uvaregel mosifin shalosh liftichat shaar hattachton vehu shaar ezrat nashim veshalosh liftichat shaar haelyon hu shaar nikkanor velamma nikra shaar elyon lefi shehu lemala meezrat nashim. vechen tokin shalosh lemilluy hammayim shemmenassechin bechag veen tokim lemilluy hammayim beshabbat. vetokin shalosh al gabbe hammizbeach beshaa shemmenassechin hammayim. vechol hattokim shettokim al hakkarbanot mittachat yad ze sheal hameshorrim uvirshuto. vechol ellu hattekiot bachatzotzrot hen:
Ze sheal hatztziltzal hu hammaamid kol hameshorrim al pi kele shir shessoadin im haleviyyim kemo shebbearnu:

Ze sheal happeyasot hu mefis ben hakkohanim bechol yom ad sheyyihye kol ish veish ose melachto shezzacha bah bappayis. vearba peamim hayu mefisin bechol yom uvehilchot temidin avaer ketzad hayu mefisin:

Hamemunne sheal hakkinnim hu shepposkin immo sheyyimkor hakkinnim lakkarbanot kach vechach bassela vechol mi shehu chayyav torim o shene bene yona yavi demehem lammikdash. veze hamemunne noten hakkinnim levaale hakkarbanot veose cheshbon im haggizbarin venotnin lo. mishsheloshim yom lishloshim yom poskin immo hashshaar. veim huzelu hakkinnim maspik keshaar hazzol veim hukeru maspik kemo sheppasku immo sheyyad hekdesh al haelyona. vechen ken shennimtza pasul o shennifsal kodem sheyyikkarev noten acher tachtav:
Ze sheal hachotamot hu shemmekabbel deme hannesachim mimmechuyyeve nesachim venoten lahen chotamot. veze sheal hannesachim hu shemmocher hannesachim:
Ketzad. arba chotamot hayu bammikdash. haechad katuv alav egel. vehashsheni katuv alav zachar. vehashshelishi katuv alav gedi. veharvii katuv alav chote:

Kol mi sheyyavi karbenotav lammikdash noten deme hannesachim leze hamemunne al hachotamot venoten lo chotamot keminyan hakkarbanot shello. veim haya metzora ashir noten lo chotam echad shekkatuv alav chote vehalla holech bachotamot shebbeyado leze hamemunne al hannesachim venoten lo nesachim keminyan hachotamot uchemo shekkatuv bahen velaerev baim ze etzel ze motzi et hachotamot umekabbel kenegdan maot im hotiru hammaot hotiru lahekdesh veim pachatu hammaot yeshallem ze sheal hachotamot mibbeto. mi sheavad chotamo mamtinin lo ad haerev im matzu bammaot yeter kede chotam shettoen notnin lo veim lav en notnin lo. veshem kol hayyom katuv al hachotam mippene harammaim shello yashhe hachotam etzlo ad sheyyukeru hannesachim:

Mishsheloshim yom lishloshim yom poskin shaar hayyayin vehassolet im hamemunne al hannesachim. im hukeru nesachim mesappek lahen kemo sheppasku immo. veim huzelu mesappek lahen keshaar hazzol. vehassachar shemmistakker hahekdesh bisharim ellu hu hannikra motar nesachim velokchin bo olot lekayitz hammizbeach. veen mekayyetzin et hammizbeach beolot of sheen bekarbenot hatztzibbur of:

Hakkohanim mippene shehen omdin al haritzpa tamid veochlin basar harebe veen alehen begadim bishat haavoda ella chaluk echad hem cholin bimehen. lefichach maamidin memunne echad sheyyihye mevakker otan umerappe kol tachluehen veosek bahen tamid hu vaanashav shettachat yado:

Vechen memannin acher lihyot chofer borot veshichin umetakken habborot shel rabbim kede sheyyihyu hammayim metzuyin birushalayim lechol echad miyyoshveha ulechol ole hargalim. veechad memunne al kol ummane lechem happanim vehu metakken kol melachto. veechad memunne al kol ummane hakketoret vehu metakken melachtah:

Ze sheal happarochet memunne al kol orge happarochot veharokmin bahen sheyyihyu muchanot lahechol velashshearim. ushete parochot hayu osin bechol shana lehavedil ben hakkodesh lekodesh hakodashim. vechute happarochet kefulin shishsha shishsha. vearbaa minin hayu bah shesh utechelet veargaman vetolaat shani. vechol echad mehen kaful shishsha hare arbaa veesrim chutin. vetefach haya avyah veal shenayim veshivim nirin hayta neereget arkah arbaim amma verachbah esrim amma:
Ushelosh esre parochot hayu bemikdash sheni sheva al shiva shaare haazara veachat al petach haulam veachat al petach hahechol ushetayim laddevir beno uven hakkodesh ushetayim kenegdan baaliyya:

Parochet shennitmet bivlad hatuma matbilin otah bifnim umachnisin otah miyyad lefi sheenah tzericha haarev shemesh. veshennitmet beav hatuma matbilin otah mibbachutz veshotchin otah bachel mippene shehi tzericha haarev shemesh. veim hayta chadasha shotchin otah al gav haitztabba kede sheyyire haam et melachtah shehi naa:
Vechol hakkelim shehayu bammikdash hayu lahem sheniyyim ushelishim sheim yittammeu harishonim yaviu hashsheniyyim tachtehem:
Ze hammemunne al maase bigde kehunna osek bahachanat bigde kohanim hedyotim uvigde kohen gadol uvaarigatan umittachat yado naasa hakkol. velishka hayta lo bammikdash:

Vigde kehunna shelosha minim. bigde kohen hedyot. uvigde zahav. uvigde lavan. bigde kohen hedyot hem arbaa kelim kuttonet umichnasayim umigbaot veavnet. vearbaatan shel pishtan levanim vechutan kaful shishsha. vehaavnet levaddo rakum betzemer:

Bigde zahav hen bigde kohen gadol vehem shemona kelim. haarbaa shel kol kohen. umeil veefod vechoshen vetzitz. veavneto shel kohen gadol maase rokem hu vehu dome bemaasav leavnet kohen hedyot. umitznefet haamura beaharon hi hammigbaat haamura bevanav. ella shekkohen gadol tzonef bah kemi shellofef al hashshever. uvanav tzonfin bah kechova ulefichach nikret migbaat:

Bigde lavan hem arbaa kelim shemmeshammesh bahen kohen gadol beyom hakkippurim. kuttonet. umichnasayim. veavnet. umitznefet. vearbaatan levanim vechutan kaful shishsha umin happishtan levaddo hem. ushete kuttanot acherot hayu lo lechohen gadol beyom hakkippurim. achat lovshah bashshachar veachat ben haarbayim. ushetehem bishloshim mane mishshel hekdesh. veim ratza lehosif mosif mishshello umakdish hattosefet veachar kach ose bah hakkuttonet:

Bigde kehunna mitzvatan sheyyihyu chadashim naim umeshulleshalim kederech bigde haggedolim shenneemar <small>(Shemot 28 2)</small> <small>(Shemot 28 40)</small> "lechavod uletifaret". hayu metushttashin o mekorain o arukkin yeter al middato o ketzarim pachot mimmiddato o shessilkkan baavnet veavad avodato pesula. hayu meshochakin o shehayu arukkim vesilkkan baavnet ad shennaasu kemiddato veavad avodato keshera:

Kol beged mibbigde kehunna shennaasu tzoin en melabbenin otan veen mechabbesin otan ella mannichan liftilot velovesh chadashim. uvigde kohen gadol shebbalu gonzin otan. uvigde lavan sheoved bahem beyom hatztzom eno oved bahem paam sheniyya leolam ella nignnazin bammakom sheyyifshot otam sham shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 16 23)</small> "vehinnicham sham" vehem asurin bahanaa:

Michnese kohanim hedyotim shebbalu veavnetehem hayu osin mehen petilot umadlikin bahen bammikdash besimchat bet hashshoeva. vechuttenot kohanim hedyotim shebbalu hayu osin mehen petilot limnorat tamid:

Kol bigde hakkohanim enan baim ella mishshel tzibbur. veyachid shehitnaddev beged mibbigde kehunna mosro latztzibbur umuttar. vechen kol kele hashsharet vaatze hammaaracha shemmesaran yachid latztzibbur hare hen kesherin. af kol karbenot hatztzibbur shehitnaddev otan yachid mishshello kesherim uvilvad sheyyimserem latztzibbur:

Bigde kohanim hedyotim hayu osin mehen machalatzot rabbot. veshishsha vetishim challon hayu bammikdash lehaniach bahen habbegadim arbaa challonot lechol mishmar. veshem kol mishmar katuv al challonotav. vechullan setumot. uchesheyyikkansu anshe mishmar laavoda bashshabbat shellahen potchin challonotehen kol yeme shabbatan venotlin hakkelim. uchesheyyetzu machazirin habbegadim lechallonotehen vesotmin:

Velamma asu arbaa challonot lechol mishmar. lefi shello yihyu hakkelim meoravin. ella kol hammichnasayim bechallon echad vechatuv alav michnesayim. vechol haavnetim bechallon echad vechatuv alav avnet. vechen hammitznafot kullan bechallon echad. vehakkuttanot kullan bechallon echad:
Kohen gadol manniach bigde zahav ballishka shello ballayla o beet sheyyetze min hammikdash:
Bigde kehunna muttar lehanot bahen. lefichach lovsham beyom avodato vaafillu shello bishat avoda chutz min haavnet mippene shehu shaatnez:
Asur lechohen hedyot lelovsho ella bishat avoda. en hakkohanim lovshin laavoda ella tzemer ufishtim bilvad:

Vechol makom shenneemar battora shesh o bad hu happishtim vehu habbutz. utechelet haamura bechol makom hi hatztzemer hatztzavua keetzem shamayim shehu patuch min hakkochal. haargaman hu hatztzemer hatztzavua adom. vetolaat hashshani hu hatztzemer hatztzavua betolaat:

Kol makom shenneemar battora shesh o shesh mashzar tzarich sheyyihye hachut kaful shishsha. umakom shenneemar bad im haya chut echad levaddo kasher. umitzva min hammuvchar sheyyihye kaful shishsha. umakom shenneemar bo mashzar bilvad tzarich sheyyihye chutan kaful shemone:
Kol makom shenneemar battora maase rokem hu shettihyena hatztzurot hannaasot baariga nirot mitztzad echad bifne haarig. umaase choshev hu shettihye hatztzura niret mishshene tzedadin panim veachor:

Vechetzad maase habbegadim. hakkuttonet ben shel kohen gadol ben shel kohen hedyot mishbetzot hayta shehi battim battim baarigatah kemo bet hakkosot kederech sheosin haorgin babbegadim hakkashim. uvet yad shelah neerag bifne atzmo umechabberin oto im guf hakkuttonet bitfira:
Orecha hakkuttonet ad lemala min heakev. veorech bet yad shelah ad pas yado. verachbo kerochav hayyad:

Hammichnasayim ben shel kohen gadol ben shel kohen hedyot hem mimmatnayim ad yerechayim shehu lemala min hattibbur karov min hallev ad sof hayyarech shehu haarkuva. ushenatzim yesh lahem. veen lahem lo bet hannekev velo bet haerva ella mukkafin kemin kis:

Hammitznefet shel kohen gadol o hedyot arko shesh esre ammot. vehaavnet rachbo kemo shalosh etzbaot vearko shenayim usheloshim amma. makkifo umachaziro kerech al gabbe kerech. uvigde kehunna kullan en osin otan maase machat ella maase oreg shenneemar <small>(Shemot 28 32)</small> <small>(Shemot 39 22)</small> <small>(Shemot 39 27)</small> "maase oreg":

Ketzad maase hatztzitz. ose tas shel zahav rochav shete etzbaot umakkif meozen leozen vechotev alav sheni shitin kodesh laAdonai kodesh millematta laAdonai milmala. veim ketavo beshita achat kasher. ufeamim ketavuhu beshita achat:
Vehaotiyyot boltot befanav. [ketzad]. chofer et haotiyyot meacharav vehu medubbak al hashshaava ad shebbolet. vehu nakuv bishte ketzotav. ufetil techelet lematta mimmennu nichnas minnekev lenekev kede sheyyihye nikshar biftil keneged haoref:
Hammeil kullo techelet. vechutav kefulin shenem asar ufiv arug bitchillat arigato. veen lo bet yad ella nechlak lishte kenafayim missof haggaron ad lematta kederech kol hammeilim veeno mechubbar ella keneged kol haggaron bilvad. vehakkorea pi hammeil loke shenneemar <small>(Shemot 28 32)</small> <small>(Shemot 39 23)</small> "lo yikkarea". vehu haddin lechol bigde kehunna shehakkoran derech hashechata loke: 
Umevi techelet veargaman vetolaat shani kol min mishshelashtan shazur shemona lefi shenneemar beshulav <small>(Shemot 39 24)</small> "mashzar". nimtzeu chute hashshulayim arbaa veesrim. veose otan kemin rimmonim shello patchu pihen vetole otan bammeil. umevi shenayim veshivim zugim uvahem shenayim veshivim inbolim hakkol zahav vetole bo shishsha usheloshim beshule kanaf ze veshishsha usheloshim beshule kanaf ze. vehazzug im hainbol hattaluy ben shenehem keechad nikra paamon ad sheyyihyu shulav mishshene tzedadav <small>(Shemot 39 26)</small> "paamon verimmon paamon verimmon":
Hazzahav shebbaarigat haefod vehachoshen haamur battora kacha hu maasehu. lokeach chut echad zahav tahor venotno im shishsha chutin shel techelet vechofel hashshiva chutin keachat. vechen hu ose chut zahav im shishsha shel argaman vechut echad im shishsha shel tolaat shani. vechut echad im shishsha shel pishtim. nimtzeu arbaa chute zahav venimtzeu kol hachutim shemona veesrim shenneemar <small>(Shemot 39 3)</small> "vayrakkeu et pache hazzahav" vegomer <small>(Shemot 39 3)</small> "laasot betoch hattechelet uvetoch haargaman uvetoch tolaat hashshani uvetoch hashshesh" melammed shechut hazzahav kaful betochan:
Ketzad maase hachoshen. oreg beged maase choshev min hazzahav vehattechelet vehaargaman vetolaat hashshani vehashshesh al shemona veesrim chutin kemo shebbearnu arko amma verachbo zeret vechoflo lishnayim. nimtza zeret al zeret merubba. vekovea bo arbaa turim shel even hameforashim battora kol even mehen merubba umeshukka bevayit shel zahav shemmakkifo millematta umearba ruchotav:
Umefatteach al haavanim shemot hashshevatim ketoldotam venimtza kotev al haodem reuven veal yashfe binyamin. vechotev battechilla lemala meruven avraham yitzchak veyaakov vechotev lematta mibbinyamin shivte yah kede sheyyihyu kol haotiyyot metzuyot sham:
Veose al arba zaviyyot shel choshen arba tabbeot zahav. venoten bishte hattabbaot shel mala shehachoshen nitle bahen shete avotot hazzahav. vehem hannikraim sharsherot. venoten bishte tabbaot shel matta shehen keneged haddadim shene petile techelet:
Haefod rachbo kerochav gabbo shel adam mikkatef lechatef. vearko mikkeneged atztzile hayyadayim meachorav ad haraglayim. veyesh lo kemo shete yadot yotzot mimmennu baarig lechan ulechan shechogrin oto bahem vehem hannikrain cheshev haefod. vehakkol arug zahav techelet veargaman vetolaat shani veshesh al shemona veesrim chutin kemaase hachoshen. vetofer alav shete ketefot kede sheyyihyu al kitfot hakkohen. vekovea al kol katef vechatef even shoham merubba mushka bevayit shel zahav. umefatteach al shete haavanim shemot hashshevatim. shishsha al even zo veshishsha al even zo ketoldotam. vechotvin shem yosef yehosef. venimtzeu 25 ot beeven zo vech ot beeven zo. vechach hayu ketuvin: vehaeven shekkatuv bah reuven al ketefo hayemanit. vehaeven shekkatuv bah shimon al ketefo hassemalit. veose bechol katef shete tabbaot achat millemala berosh hakkatef veachat millematta lakkatef lemala min hacheshev. venoten shete avotot zahav bishte tabbaot shellemala vehem hannikraim sharsherot:
Veachar kach machnis ketzot haavotot shel choshen battabbaot shel mala bechitfot haefod. umachnis shene petile hattechelet shebbeshule hachoshen bishte hattabbaot shel mala mecheshev haefod. umoridin et hashsharsherot shebbetabbeot kitfot haefod ad tabbeot hachoshen haelyonot kede sheyyiddavku ze baze <small>(Shemot 28 28)</small> <small>(Shemot 39 21)</small> "velo yizzach hachoshen meal haefod". vechol hammeziach choshen meal haefod umefarek chibburan derech kilkul loke: 
Nimtza keshellovesh haefod im hachoshen yihye hachoshen al libbo beshave vehaefod meacharav vecheshev haefod kashur al libbo tachat hachoshen. ushete kitfot haefod al shete ketefav. ushete avotot zahav yordot meal ketefav mikkan umikkan mikkitfot haefod ad tabbeot hachoshen. ushene chute techelet merukkasin mittachat atztzile yadav. mishshete tabbeot hachoshen hattachtonot ad shete tabbeot kitfot haefod hattachtonot shehem lemala min hacheshev:

Ketzad seder levishat habbegadim. lovesh hammichnasayim techilla vechoger et hammichnasayim lemala mittibburo meal matnav. veachar kach lovesh hakkuttonet. veachar kach choger et haavnet keneged atztzile yadav umakkifo kerech al kerech ad sheggomer vekosher:

Veal haavnet meforash bakkabbala <small>(Yechezkel 44 18)</small> "velo yachgeru bayyaza" bemakom shemmeziin. vechach kibbel yonatan ben uziel mippi hanneviim vetirgem al levavehon yesrun. veachar kach tzonef bammitznefet kemin kova:

Kohen gadol achar shechoger beavnet lovesh hammeil. veal hammeil haefod vehachoshen vechoger becheshev haefod al hammeil mittachat hachoshen ulefichach nikra <small>(Shemot 28 lo)</small> <small>(Shemot 29 5)</small> <small>(Shemot 39 22)</small> "meil haefod" shechogro baefod. veachar kach tzonef bammitznefet vekosher hatztzitz lemala min hammitznefet usearo haya nira ben tzitz lammitznefet vesham haya meniach tefillin ben tzitz lammitznefet:

Mitzvat ase laasot begadim ellu velihyot hakkohen oved bahen shenneemar <small>(Shemot 28 2)</small> "veasita vigde kodesh". <small>(Shemot 29 8)</small> "veet banav takriv vehilbashtam kuttonot". vechohen gadol sheshshimmesh befachot mishshemona begadim ellu o kohen hedyot sheshshimmesh befachot mearbaa begadim ellu hu hannikra mechussar begadim vaavodato pesula vechayyav mita bide shamayim kezar sheshshimmesh shenneemar <small>(Shemot 29 9)</small> "vechagarta otam avnet" <small>(Shemot 29 9)</small> "vehayta lahem kehunna". bizman shebbigdehem alehen kehunnatan alehen. en bigdehen alehen en kehunnatam alehen ella hare hem kezarim veneemar <small>(Bamidbar 1 51)</small> <small>(Bamidbar 3 10)</small> <small>(Bamidbar 3 38)</small> <small>(Bamidbar 18 7)</small> "vehazzar hakkarev yumat":

Keshem shehammechussar begadim chayyav mita ufosel haavoda. kach hayyater begadim kegon shellavash shete kuttonot o shene avnetim o kohen hedyot shellavash bigde kohen gadol veavad hare ze mechallel haavoda vechayyav mita bide shamayim:

Neemar bevigde kehunna <small>(Vayikra 16 4)</small> "al besaro" <small>(Vayikra 16 4)</small> "ulevesham". melammed shello yihye davar chotzetz ben besaro labbegadim. afillu nima achat o afar o kinna meta im hayta ben basar labbeged hare zo chatzitza vaavodato pesula. lefichach en hakkohen yachol laavod bitfillin shel yad shehare chotzetzet. aval shel rosh enah chotzetzet. veim ratza lahanicham bishat haavoda meniach:

Vetzarich lehizzaher beshaa shellovesh shello yihye avak ben bigdo livsaro velo kinna af al pi shehi bachayyim. veshello tikkanes haruach bishat haavoda ben besaro levigdo ad sheyyitrachek habbeged mealav. velo yachnis yado tachat chaluko lachek. velo yetze searo min habbeged. velo yihye babbeged nima meduldelet. veim haya sham echad mikkol ellu avodato keshera:

Karach al besaro beged shello bimkom begadim kegon shekkeracho al etzbao o al akevo im haya bo shalosh etzbaot al shalosh etzbaot hare ze chotzetz ufosel. pachot mikkan eno chotzetz. veim haya tziltzul katan hoil vehu chashuv beged bifne atzmo hare ze posel veaf al pi sheen bo shalosh al shalosh:

Kohen shellaka beetzbao muttar lichroch aleha gemi beshabbat o beged sheen bo shalosh al shalosh veoved. veim nitkavven lehotzi dam asur. vehu shello yachotz haggemi o habbeged ben besaro lakkeli bishat avoda:

Asu bevayit sheni urim vetummim kede lehashelim shemona begadim veaf al pi shello hayu nishalin bahen. umippene ma lo hayu shoalin bahen mippene shello hayta sham ruach hakkodesh vechol kohen sheeno medabber beruach hakkodesh veen shechina shora alav en nishalin bo:

Vechetzad shoalin. omed hakkohen ufanav lifne haaron vehashshoel meacharav. panav leachare hakkohen. veomer hashshoel eele o lo eele. veeno shoel bekol ram velo mehareher belibbo ella bekol namuch kemi shemmitpallel beno leven atzmo. umiyyad ruach hakkodesh lovesh et hakkohen umabbit bachoshen veroe bo bemare hannevua ale o lo taale baotiyyot shebboltot min hachoshen keneged panav. vehakkohen meshivo veomer lo ale o lo taale:

Veen shoalin al shene devarim keechad. veim shaal meshivin al harishon bilvad. veen nishalin bahen lehedyot ella o lemelech o levet din o lemi shetztzorech hatztzibbur bo shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 27 21)</small> "velifne elazar hakkohen yaamod vegomer. "hu" ze hammelech. "vechol bene yisrael" ze hu meshuach milchama o mi shetztzorech hatztzibbur bishelato. "vechol haeda" ellu bet din haggadol:

Ze sheatta motze bedivre neviim shehakkohanim hayu chogrin efod bad lo hayu kohanim gedolim. sheen haefod shel kohen gadol efod bad. veaf haleviyyim hayu chogrin oto shehare shemuel hannavi levi haya veneemar bo <small>(Shmuel 1 2 18)</small> "naar chagur efod bad". ella efod ze hayu chogrim oto bene hanneviim umi shehu rauy shettishre alav ruach hakkodesh lehodia ki higgia ze lemaalat kohen gadol shemmedabber al pi haefod vehachoshen beruach hakkodesh:
Mishneh Torah, Virgin Maiden 1:
Mi sheppitta betula konsin oto mishkal chamishshim selaim shel kesef mezukkak vehu hannikra kenas. vechen im anas otah. ukenas ze mitzvat ase shel tora shenneemar <small>(Devarim 22 29)</small> "venatan haish hashshochev immah laavi hannaara chamishshim kesef": 
Vee ze hu mefatte vee ze hu ones. mefatte lirtzonah. ones shebba aleha beal karchah. kol hannivelet bassade hare zo bechezkat anusa vedanin otah bedin anusa ad sheyyaidu haedim shebbirtzonah nivala. vechol hannivelet bair hare zo bechezkat mefutta mippene shello zaaka ad sheyyaidu haedim shehi anusa, kegon sheshshalaf lah cherev veamar lah im tizaki eherog otach: 
Hamefutta shello ratzta lehinnase lamfatte. o shello ratza aviha littenah lo. o shello ratza hu lichnos. hare ze noten kenas veholech veen kofin oto lichnos. veim ratzu uchenasah eno meshallem kenas ella kotev lah ketubba kishar habbetulot. aval haanusa shello ratzta hi o aviha lehinnase leones harshut beyadam venoten kenas veholech. ratzta hi veaviha velo ratza hu kofin oto vechones venoten kenas shenneemar <small>(Devarim 22 29)</small> "velo tihye leishsha" hare zo mitzvat ase. afillu hi chiggeret o suma o metzoraat kofin oto lichnos veeno motzi lirtzono leolam shenneemar <small>(Devarim 22 19)</small> "lo yuchal leshallechah kol yamav" hare zo mitzvat lo taase: 
Veen lah ketubba shello tikkenu chachamim ketubba leishsha ella kede shello tihye kalla beenav lehotziah veze eno yachol lehotziah: 
Hayta anusa zo asura alav afillu mechayyave ase vaafillu sheniyya hare ze lo yissaenna. vechen im nimtza bah devar zimma achar shekkanas hare ze yegarshenah shenneemar <small>(Devarim 22 29)</small> "velo tihye leishsha". ishsha haruya lo: 
Kohen gadol sheanas betula o sheppitta otah hare ze lo yichnos mippene shehu metzuvve likkach et habbetula uveshaa sheyyissa zo enah betula. veim kanas yotzi beget: 
Af al pi shenneemar beones <small>(Devarim 22 19)</small> "lo yuchal leshallechah" kevan shekkedamo ase shenneemar <small>(Devarim 22 29)</small> "velo tihye leishsha" hare ze nitteko laase venimtzet zo mitzvat lo taase shennittekah laase sheen lokin aleha ella im lo kiyyem ase shebbah kemo sheyyitbaer behilchot sanhedrin. lefichach haones sheavar vegeresh kofin oto lehachazir veeno loke. meta gerushato kodem sheyyachzirenna o nitkaddesha leacher o shehaya kohen sheasur bigrusha hare ze loke shehare avar al lo taase veeno yachol lekayyem ase shebbah: 
En haones o hamefatte chayyav biknas ad sheyyavo aleha [kedarkah] uveedim veeno tzarich hateraa. umeematay yihye labbat kenas. meachar shalosh shanim gemurot ad shettivgor. nivala betoch shalosh shanim en biatah bia. ba aleha mishshebbagra en lah kenas shenneemar <small>(Devarim 22 28)</small> "naara vetula" lo habbogeret: 
Veachat sheyyesh lah av veachat sheen lah av yesh lah kenas. veellu sheen lahen kenas. habbogeret vehamemaenet vehaaylonit vehashshota vehachereshet. umi sheyyatza aleha shem ra beyaldutah uvau shenayim veheidu shettava otan liznot immah. vehamegoreshet min hannissuin vaadayin hi naara betula. aval hamegoreshet min haerusin im neensa yesh lah kenas ukenasah leatzmah. veim nitpatteta en lah kenas: 
Haggiyyoret vehashshevuya vehameshuchreret im nitgayyera venifdet venishtachrera vehi bat shalosh shanim o pachot yesh lah kenas. veim hayta bat shalosh shanim veyom echad keshennitgayyera o keshennifdet o keshennishtachrera en lah kenas hoil uviatan bia hare hen kivulot: 
Hayta betula zo asura al haones o hamefatte im hayta achat mechayyave keretot kegon achoto o dodato vehannidda vechayyotze bahen o shehayta mechayyave lavin im hitru bo hare ze loke veeno meshallem kenas sheen adam loke umeshallem. veim lo hayta sham hateraa hoil veeno chayyav malkot hare ze meshallem kenas: 
Hayta mechayyave ase o sheniyya vechayyotze bahen sheasura middivre sofrim. ben hitru bo ben lo hitru bo chayyav biknas sheen kan malkot: 
Hayta mechayyave mitat bet din kegon bitto veeshet beno vechayyotze bahen ben hitru bo ben lo hitru bo patur min hakkenas shenneemar <small>(Shemot 21 22)</small> "velo yihye ason anosh yeanesh" ha im haya sham ason en sham onesh. veaf al pi sheharigat haishsha bishgaga shehare lo nitkavvenu lah shenneemar <small>(Shemot 21 22)</small> "ki yinnatzu anashim venagfu ishsha" ha lamadta shello chillek hakkatuv beason ben shogeg lemezid lefatro min hattashlumin. vahare hu omer <small>(Vayikra 24 18)</small> "makke nefesh behema yeshallemenna" <small>(Vayikra 24 21)</small> "umakke adam yumat" ma makke nefesh behema lo chillek hakkatuv ben shogeg lemezid lechayyevo betashlumin af makke nefesh adam lo chillek hakkatuv ben shogeg lemezid lefatro min hattashlumin: 
Vechen haddin lechol avera sheyyesh bah mitat bet din sheen bah tashlumin: 
Ba aleha umeta hare ze patur min hakkenas shenneemar <small>(Devarim 22 29)</small> "venatan haish hashshochev immah laavi hannaara" lo laavi hammeta. vehu shettamut kodem shettaamod baddin:
Mishneh Torah, Virgin Maiden 2:
Chamishim kesef shel kenas hem deme hanaat shechiva bilvad. vechayyav hamefatte litten boshet ufegam yoter al hakkenas hakkatzuv battora. yeter alav haones shehu noten et hatztzaar. shehannivelet birtzonah en lah tzaar vaanusa yesh lah tzaar. vechen hu omer baanusa <small>(Devarim 22 29)</small> "tachat asher innah": 
Nimtza hamefatte meshallem shelosha devarim kenas uvoshet ufegam. vehaones arbaa kenas uvoshet vetzaar ufegam: 
Kenas shave bakkol. echad habba al bat kohen gadol veechad habba al bat ger o mamzer kenasah chamishshim kesef. aval habboshet vehappegam vehatztzaar enan shavin lakkol utzerichin shuma: 
Ketzad shamin habboshet. hakkol lefi hamevayyesh vehammitbayyesh. sheeno dome mevayyesh naara chashuva umimmishpacha meyuchasa limvayyesh ketanna aniyya bezuya. veeno dome mitbayyesh meadam chashuv vegadol lemitbayyesh meechad mehannevalim vekal min hakkallim: 
Ulefi ze roin haddayyanin maalato umaalatah veshamin kamma mamon rauy leaviha ulemishpachtah litten velo yeera lahen davar ze meadam ze vechamohu chayyav leshallem: 
Pegam lefi yafyah. roin otah keillu hi shifcha nimkeret bashshuk kamma hi shava beula vechamma hayta shava betula. sheadam rotze liknot shifcha betula littenah leavdo shehu rotze bahanayato vetovato. veroin kamma pachata vishallem tzaar lefi katnutah uvinyan gufah. ulefi shanav vegufo omdin kamma haav rotze litten velo titztaer zo mizze veyitten: 
Hamefatte noten boshet ufegam miyyad veeno noten hakkenas ella im ken lo nesaah shenneemar <small>(Shemot 22 16)</small> "veim maen yemaen aviha letittah lo kesef yishkl". aval haones noten arbaa devarim miyyad vechones. lefichach keshettirtze lehitgaresh o titalmen en lah kelum: 
Bau aleha shenayim echad kedarkah veechad shello kedarkah ze shebba aleha shello kedarkah im hu rishon chayyav bevoshet ufegam veim hu acharon chayyav bevoshet bilvad shekkevar nifgema. veze shebba aleha kedarkah ben rishon ben acharon chayyav biknas uvishar haddevarim. aval en boshet ufegam shel bat shello nivala kelal kevoshet ufegam zo shennivala shello kedarkah: 
Kevar hodanu habbanot sheen lahen kenas veeser hen. habbogeret. vehamemaenet. vehamegoreshet. vehaaylonit. vehashshota. vehachereshet. vehaggiyyoret. vehashshevuya. vehameshuchreret. vehayyotze aleha shem ra. ushear habbanot yesh lahen kenas: 
Kol bat sheyyesh lah kenas yesh lah boshet ufegam. veim hayta anusa yesh lah tzaar. vechol bat sheen lah kenas kach en lah lo boshet velo pegam im nitpatteta vechen im neensa chutz mibbogeret umemaenet veshota vechereshet: 
Ketzad. haones et habbogeret veet hamemaenet af al pi sheen lahen kenas yesh lahen boshet ufegam vetzaar. vehaones shota o chereshet meshallem tzaar bilvad. aval hamefatte et kullan patur mikkelum: 
En adam meshallem kenas bechol makom behodaat piv ella al pi edim. lefichach haomer anasti o pittiti bitto shel peloni eno meshallem kenas aval meshallem boshet ufegam behodaat piv. vechen bat shettava ish baddin veamra lo anasta o pittita oti vehu omer lo hayu devarim meolam hare ze nishba shevuat hesset sheillu hoda haya meshallem lah boshet ufegam vetzaar al pi atzmo: 
Amra lo anasta oti vehu omer lo ki ella pittiti hare ze nishba shevuat hattora al deme hatztzaar umeshallem boshet ufegam shehare hoda bemiktzat hattaana kemo sheyyitbaer bimkomo: 
Shelosha devarim shel mefatte vearbaa shel ones hare hen shel av shekkol shevach neurim lo. veim en lah av hare hen shel atzmah: 
Mefutta o anusa shello tava ad shebbagra o ad shennisset o ad shemmet haav haarbaa devarim o hashshelosha shellah. amda baddin vetava oto veachar kach bagra o shennisset hare hen shel av. veim met haav achar amidatah baddin hare hen shel achin shehen yorshe haav. shemmeet sheamda bedin zacha bahen haav: 
Habbat shennitarsa venitgarsha kenasah levaddo leatzmah. neensa o nitpatteta veachar kach nitkaddesha leacher kenasah ushear haddevarim leaviha. sheen haerusin motziin mershut av: 
Ani omer shezze shenneemar battora <small>(Vayikra 19 29)</small> "al techallel et bittecha lehazenotah". shello yomar haav hoil velo chiyyeva tora mefatte veones ella sheyyitten mamon laav hareni socher bitti habbetula laze lavo aleha bechol mamon sheertze o aniach ze lavo aleha bechinnam sheyyesh lo laadam limchol mamono lechol mi sheyyirtze lechach neemar al techallel et bittecha. shezze shechiyyeva tora laones velamfatte mamon velo malkot besheera haddavar mikre shello middaat aviha velo hechina atzmah lechach sheddavar ze eno hove tamid veeno matzuy. aval im heniach bitto habbetula muchenet lechol mi sheyyavo aleha gorem shettimmale haaretz zimma venimtza haav nose bitto vehaach nose achoto sheim titabber veteled lo yivvada ben mi hu. vehammechin bitto lechach hare hi kedesha veloke habboel vehannivelet mishshum <small>(Devarim 23 18)</small> "lo tihye kedesha". veen konsin oto shello chiyyeva tora kenas ella leones umefatte aval zo shehechina atzmah lechach ben middatah ben middaat aviha hare zo kedesha. veissur kedesha echad hu ben bivtula ben bivula lefichach amru chachamim shehayyotze aleha shem ra beyaldutah en lah kenas kemo shebbearnu shehare zo bechezkat shehifkira atzmah ledavar ze birtzonah:
Mishneh Torah, Virgin Maiden 3: Hammotzi shem ra al bat yisrael venimtza haddavar sheker loke shenneemar <small>(Devarim 22 18)</small> "veyisseru oto". veazhara shello mi<small>(Vayikra 19 16)</small> "lo telech rachil beammecha". venoten leaviha mishkal mea selaim kesef mezukkak. veim hayta yetoma hare hem shel atzmah:

Vehammotzi shem ra al hakketanna o al habbogeret patur min hakkenas umin hammalkot. veeno chayyav ad sheyyotzi al hannaara shenneemar <small>(Devarim 22 15)</small> "vehotziu et betule hannaara" naara male dibber hakkatuv:

En danin din ze ella bifne habbayit uvet din shel esrim ushelosha. mippene sheyyesh bedin motzi shem ra dine nefashot. sheim nimtza haddavar kemo shenneemar hare zo nehereget. aval haones vehamefatte danin bahen bechol zeman bishlosha kemo sheyyitbaer behilchot sanhedrin:

Umitzvat ase shel tora shetteshev eshet motzi shem ra tachtav leolam shenneemar <small>(Devarim 22 19)</small> "velo tihye leishsha" afillu ivveret o mukkat shechin. veim gershah avar al lo taase shenneemar <small>(Devarim 22 19)</small> "lo yuchal leshallechah kol yamav". vechofin oto umachazir veeno loke kemo shebbearnu beones. veim kiddem echad vekiddeshah o shemmeta o shehaya kohen sheasur bigrusha hare ze loke al gerusheha:

Nimtza bah devar zimma. o shennimtzet asura alav mechayyave lavin o mechayyave ase vaafillu sheniyya hare ze yegarshenna beget shenneemar <small>(Devarim 22 19)</small> "velo tihye leishsha" ishsha haruya lo. velamma lo yavo ase veyidche et lo taase ben bemotzi shem ra ben beones veyissa zo haasura lo. shehare efshar shello tirtze hi leshev venimtza ase velo taase kayyamin:

Ketzad hotzaat shem ra. hu sheyyavo levet din veyomar naara zo baalti velo matzati lah betulim ucheshebbikkashti al haddavar noda li shezzinneta tachtay achar sheerastiha veellu hem eday shezzinneta bifnehem. uvet din shomin divre haedim vechokrin edutan. im nimtza haddavar emet niskelet. veim hevi haav edim vehuzemu haedim shehevi habbaal venimtza sheheidu sheker yissaklu veyilke hu venoten mea selaim. veal ze neemar <small>(Devarim 22 17)</small> "veelle betule vitti", ellu haedim sheyyazimu ede habbaal. chazar habbaal vehevi edim acherim vehezimu ede haav hare hannaara veede aviha niskalin. al ze neemar <small>(Devarim 22 20)</small> "veim emet haya haddavar hazze". mippi hashshemua lamdu shepparasha zo yesh bah edim vezommin vezomme zommin:

Hotzi aleha shem ra vehi bogeret af al pi shehevi edim shezzinneta tachtav keshehayta naara hare ze patur min hammalkot umin hakkenas. veim nimtza haddavar emet hare zo tissakel af al pi shehi bogeret hoil uveet shezzinneta naara hayta:

Kol naara sheen lah kenas im neensa o nitpatteta kach hammotzi aleha shem ra patur min hammalkot umin hattashlumin. vechen hakkutit shennitgayyera vehashshifcha shennishtachrera pechuta mibbat shalosh shanim afillu hayta horatah shello bikdushsha veledatah bikdushsha hammotzi aleha shem ra patur min hakkenas umin hammalkot shenneemar <small>(Devarim 22 19)</small> "ki hotzi shem ra al betulat yisrael" ad shettihye horatah veledatah bikdushsha:

Kiddesh naara vegershah vechazar vekiddeshah vehotzi aleha shem ra vehevi edim shezzinneta tachtav bakkiddushin harishonim venimtzeu zommim hare ze patur. vechen im hayta yevimto shekkansah vehotzi aleha shem ra vehevi edim shezzinneta tachat kiddushe achiv venimtzeu zommim hare ze patur min hammalkot umin hattashlumin. vechol happatur im ratza legaresh yegaresh:
Eno chayyav ad sheyyivol otah kedarkah veyotzi shem ra (al habbeila) kedarkah. bealah shello kedarkah veamar lo metzatiha betula patur umakkin oto makkat mardut:
Vechen im amar lo metzatiha betula velo amar shezzinneta tachtay o sheamar zinneta tachtay velo hevi edim ella bau mealehem hare ze patur af al pi shehaedim neheragim im huzammu:

Ze shenneemar battora <small>(Devarim 22 17)</small> "ufarsu hassimla" leshon kavod shennosin venotnin besitre haddavar. vechen ze sheyyomar haav <small>(Devarim 22 17)</small> "elle betule vitti" hen zomme ede habbaal. veze shenneemar <small>(Devarim 22 20)</small> "veim emet haya haddavar" tehareg keshezzinneta achar haerusin beedim shenneemar <small>(Devarim 22 21)</small> "liznot bet aviha". aval kodem haerusin kevar amra tora bah shehi petura mikkelum uvoalah chayyav betashlume mamon bilvad ben pitta ben anas:
Mishneh Torah, Vows 1: Hanneder nechlak lishte machalokot. hachelek harishon hu sheyyeesor al atzmo devarim hammuttarim lo kegon sheyyomar perot medina pelonit asurin alay kol sheloshim yom o leolam. o min peloni mipperot haolam o perot ellu asurin alay. bechol lashon sheyyeesor hare ze neesar bahen. veaf al pi sheen sham shevua kelal velo hazekarat shem velo kinnuy. veal ze neemar battora <small>(Bamidbar 30 3)</small> "lesor issar al nafsho". sheyyeesor al atzmo devarim hammuttarim. vechen im amar hare hen alay issar hare ellu asurin vechelek ze hu sheani kore oto nidre issar:

Vehachelek hashsheni hu sheyyechayyev atzmo bekarban sheeno chayyav bo. kegon sheyyomar hare alay lehavi ola. o hare alay lehavi shelamim o mincha. hare behema zo ola o shelamim. vehaomer [hare] alay hu hannikra neder. vehaomer hare zo hu hannikra nedava. vehannedava vehanneder mimmin echad hu ella shehannedarim chayyavin beacharayutan unedavot en chayyavin beacharayutan. veal ze neemar battora <small>(Devarim 12 17)</small> "unedarecha asher tiddor venidvotecha" vegomer. vechelek ze hu sheani kore oto nidre hekdesh:
Vedine hachelek harishon veinyano hem sheanu mevaarim bahalachot ellu. aval dine nidre hekdesh umishpetehem kullam yitbaaru bimkomam behilchot maase hakkarbanot:

Mitzvat ase shel tora sheyyekayyem adam shevuato o nidro ben shehaya minnidre issar ben shehaya minnidre hekdesh. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 23 24)</small> "motza sefatecha tishmor veasita kaasher nadarta" veneemar <small>(Bamidbar 30 3)</small> "kechol hayyotze mippiv yaase":

Haoser al atzmo min mimmine maachol kegon sheamar teenim asurin alay o teenim shel medina pelonit asurim alay o teenim ellu asurin alay vechayyotze beellu veachal mehen kol shehu loke min hattora shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 30 3)</small> "lo yachel devaro". sheen lindarim shiur. shekkol hannoder middavar hare ze kimfaresh kol shehu. amar achila mipperot medina pelonit asurin alay o achila mipperot ellu eno loke ad sheyyochal kezayit:
Asar al atzmo achila min hatteenim vaachila min haanavim ben beneder echad ben bishne nedarim hare ellu mitztarfin lichzayit. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Haomer perot ellu alay karban o sheamar hare hem kekarban o sheamar lachavero kol ma sheochal immecha alay karban o kekarban o hare hen alay karban. hare ellu asurin alav mippene sheefshar sheyyiddor adam karban veyaase behema shehayta chol karban veteaser:

Aval haomer perot ellu alay o min peloni alay o ma sheochal im peloni alay kivsar chazir o keakkum o kinvelot uterefot vechayyotze beellu hare ellu muttarin veen kan neder. shei efshar sheyyaase davar sheeno besar chazir kivsar chazir:
Ze hakkelal kol hammesim devarim hammuttarim kaddevarim haasurim im oto davar haasur yachol laasoto beneder hare ellu asurim. veim eno yachol laasoto beneder hare ellu muttarin:

Hachattat vehaasham af al pi sheenan bain beneder unedava kemo sheyyitbaer bimkomo efshar lannoder lehavi otam mechamat nidro. shehannoder benazir mevi chattat veim nitma mevi asham kemo sheyyitbaer. lefichach haomer perot ellu alay kechattat o keasham o sheamar hare hen chattat o hare hen asham hare ellu asurin. veen tzarich lomar beomer hare hen ola o shelamim o mincha o toda shehen asurin shekkol ellu bain beneder unedava:
Aval haomer perot ellu alay kechallat aharon o kitrumato hare ellu muttarin sheen sham derech lehavi ellu beneder unedava:
Haomer hare happerot haellu alay kenotar kefiggul kevasar tame shel kadashim hare ellu asurin shehare asaan kivsar karban mikkol makom:

Haomer hare hen alay kemaasar behema hare ellu asurin hoil ukedushshato bide adam. hare hen alay kivchor hare ellu muttarin sheen kedushshato bide adam veeno yachol lehatepiso beneder shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 27 26)</small> "lo yakdish ish oto":

Amar hare hen alay kecherme shamayim hare ellu asurin. shecherme shamayim levedek habbayit. hare hen alay kitrumat hallishka kitmidim kedirim keetzim keishshim kemizbeach o keachad mimmeshammeshe hammizbeach. kegon sheamar hare hen alay keyaim kemizrakot kemizlagot vechayyotze bahen. vechen haomer hare hen alay kehechol kirushalayim hare ellu asurin. veaf al pi shello hazekir shem karban. shekkol devarim ellu inyanam keomer hare hen alay karban:

Haya lefanav besar kodesh afillu haya besar shelamim achar zerikat damim shehu muttar lazzarim veamar hare hen alay kevasar ze hare ellu asurin. shello hitpis ella beikkaro shehaya asur. aval im haya besar bechor im lifne zerikat damim hare ze asur veim leachor zerikat damim hare ze muttar:

Yesh mekomot sheanshehem illegim umafsidin et hallashon umechannin al davar bedavar acher holchin sham achar hakkinnuy. ketzad kol kinnuye karban kekarban. haomer hare hen alay konam konach konaz hare ellu kinnuyin lekarban. cherek cheref cherech hare ellu kinnuyin lecherem. vechen kol kayyotze baze holchin achar leshon kelal haam beoto makom uveoto zeman:
Ucheshem sheoser atzmo bechinnuyin kach im hikdish bechinnuyin hare ze hekdesh. vechinnuye hakkinnuyin muttarin ben benidre issar ben benidre hekdesh:

Haomer lachavero ma sheochal immecha lo yehe chullin o lo yehe kasher o lo yehe dechi o lo yehe tahor hare ze kemi sheamar lo kol ma sheochal immecha yehe karban shehu asur. vechen im amar lo kol ma sheochal immecha tame o notar o piggul hare ze asur:

Haomer lachavero lo chullin lo ochal lecha hare ze kemi sheamar lo ma sheochal lecha lo yehe chullin ella karban. vechen im amar hakarban sheochal lecha karban sheochal lecha kekarban sheochal lecha hare ze asur. aval haomer hakkarban lo ochal lecha o kekarban lo ochal lecha o lekarban lo ochal lecha o karban lo ochal lecha o lo karban lo ochal lecha kol ellu muttarim. sheen mashma devarim ellu ella shennishba bekarban shello yochal laze vehannishba bekarban eno kelum o shennadar shello yochal lo karban:
Chullin sheochal lecha hachullin sheochal lecha kechullin sheochal lecha chullin shello ochal lecha hachullin shello ochal lecha kechullin shello ochal lecha hare ze muttar:
Aval haomer lo tame sheochal lecha lo notar sheochal lecha lo piggul sheochal lecha asur. shemmashmao shel davar davar sheochal hu sheyyihye piggul o tame lefichach lo ochal lecha:

Bahechol sheochal lecha hechol sheochal lecha lo hechol sheochal lecha asur. hechol shello ochal lecha kehechol shello ochal lecha lo hechol shello ochal lecha muttar. shezze kemi shennishba bahechol shello yochal. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Haomer lachavero muddar ani mimmecha mashma davar ze shello yedabber immo. mufrash ani mimmecha mashmao shello yissa veyitten immo. meruchak ani mimmecha mashmao shello yeshev bearba ammotav. vechen im amar lo menudde ani lecha o meshammatna mimmecha. aval im amar lo muddar ani mimmecha shello ochal lecha. o mufrash ani mimmecha shello ochal lecha o meruchak ani mimmecha shello ochal lecha hare ze asur leechol. veim achal kezayit mikkol nechasav loke mishshum <small>(Bamidbar 30 3)</small> "lo yachel devaro":
Amar lo menudde ani lecha shello ochal lecha eno ochel lo veim achal eno loke. amar lo nadina mimmecha hare ze asur lehanot:

Haomer lachavero hare alay kenidre reshaim im ochal lecha shemminnidrehem nazir vekarban ushevua veachal chayyav bechullan. vechen haomer hare alay kindavot kesherim shemminnidvotam nazir vekarban hare ze chayyav:

Amar hare alay kenidre reshaim o kindavot kesherim sheochal lecha o im ochal lecha hare ze asur af al pi shello peresh. amar kenidre kesherim lo nitchayyev bichlum sheen hakkesherim nodrim bederech issur vachaas. amar kenidre reshaim hareni vehaya nazir over lefanav chayyav binzirut. kenidre reshaim alay chayyav karban. kenidre reshaim shello ochal mimmennu chayyav bishvua:
Hannoder battora kegon sheamar perot ellu alay kazo lo amar kelum veeno tzarich sheela lechacham. ella im ken haya am haaretz. kede shello yinhagu kallut rosh bindarim:
Nadar bema shekkatuv bah hare ze asur shehare katuv bah issar veneder. netalah beyado venadar bah hare ze kemi shennadar bema shekkatuv bah:
Haomer lachavero nashkim venishne perek. alav lehashekim velikrot shezze kemo neder hu veaf al pi shello hotzio bilshon neder:

Haomer leishto hare at alay keimmi o kaachoti o kearla o kechile hakkerem hare ze keomer al happerot hare ellu kivsar chazir. keshem shehu muttar leachlan kemo shebbearnu kach muttar beishto. aval im amar lah hareni muddar mimech hanaya o hanaat tashmishech asura alay hare zo asura alav kemo sheyyitbaer:
Mishneh Torah, Vows 2:
Echad hannoder mippi atzmo o shehiddiro chavero veamar amen o davar sheinyano keinyan amen shehu kabbalat devarim: 
Veen hannoder neesar bedavar sheasar al atzmo ad sheyyotzi bisfatav veyihye piv velibbo shavin kemo shebbearnu bishvuot. aval hammitkavven lindor benazir venadar bekarban. bekarban venadar benazir. bishvua venadar. o shennitkavven lindor venishba. o shennitkavven lomar teenim veamar anavim. hare ze muttar bishnehem veen kan neder: 
Hannoder al daat acherim hare ze kenishba al daat acherim. vechen hannoder vechazar bo betoch kede dibbur o shemmichu bo betoch kede dibbur vekibbel hare ze muttar. vedin kol ellu haddevarim bindarim kedinan bishvuot: 
Mi shehitna kodem sheyyiddor veamar kol neder sheeddor mikkan vead eser shanim hareni chozer bahen o hare hen betelim vechayyotze baddevarim ellu veachar kach nadar. im haya zocher hattenay beshaa shennadar hare nidro kayyam shehare bittel hattenay beneder ze. veim lo zachar hattenay ella achar shennadar af al pi shekkibbel hattenay belibbo vekiyyemo hare hanneder batel. veaf al pi shello hotzi atta hachazara befiv kevar hikdim hachazara lanneder vehotziah befiv mikkodem. veyesh shemmore lehachemir veomer vehu sheyyizkor hattenay achar shennadar betoch kede dibbur: 
Mi shehikdim et hattenay leshana o leeser veachar kach nadar venizkar beshaa shennadar sheyyesh lo tenay veshachach al e ze davar hitna vechetzad haya hattenay. im amar al daat rishona ani ose en nidro neder shehare bittelo. veim lo amar al daat rishona ani ose kevar bittel hattenay vekiyyem hanneder shehare zachar bishat hanneder sheyyesh sham tenay veaf al pi chen nadar: 
Yesh mehaggeonim sheomrim en kol ellu haddevarim nohagin ella bindarim bilvad lo bishvuot. veyesh mi shemmore sheddin hannedarim vehashshevuot beinyanot ellu echad hem. vechi yesh lo lehakedim tenay lishvuato kederech sheamru bindarim: 
Setam nedarim lehachemir. uferushan yesh bo lehakel ulehachmir. ketzad. haomer hare happerot haellu alay kevasar maliach ucheyen nesech. omrin lo ume haya belibbecha. im peresh veamar kevasar maliach shel karban ucheyayin shennitnassech al hammizbeach haya belibbi hare ze asur. veim amar lo haya belibbi ella tikrovet akkum veyayin shennitnassech lah hare ze muttar. veim nadar setam hare ze asur: 
Vechen haomer hare happerot haellu alay cherem. im kecherem shel bedek habbayit asur. veim kecherme hakkohanim muttar. mippene shehen mamon shellahem veen bah issur. veim setam asur: 
Hare hen alay kemaaser. im kemaasar behema asur mippene shehu karban shehikdisho beyado kemo shebbearnu. veim kemaasar dagan muttar veim setam asur: 
Hare hen alay kitruma. im litrumat hallishka nitkavven hare ze asur. veim litrumat haggoren nitkavven muttar. veim setam asur. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Bamme devarim amurim bemakom shemmashma kol echad meellu sham shene inyanot. aval makom sheddarkan sheen korim cherem setam ella lecherme bedek habbayit bilvad veamar sham hare hen alay cherem hare ze asur. vechen im haya darkan sheen korim cherem setam ella lecherme kohanim hare ze muttar. vechen kol kayyotze baze sheen holchin bindarim ella achar leshon anshe oto makom beoto zeman: 
Hannoder becherem veamar lo haya belibbi ella chermo shel yam shehi hammichmoret. nadar bekarban veamar lo haya belibbi ella bekarbenot melachim. amar lachavero hare atzmi alecha karban veamar lo haya belibbi ella leasro beetzem shehinnachti li lihyot noder bo derech sechok. nadar shello tehane lo ishto veamar lo haya belibbi ella ishti rishona sheggerashtiha. vechen kol kayyotze beellu haddevarim shemmashmaan lechol haam issur vehu omer lo nitkavvanti ella lechach ulechach. im haya hannoder talmid chacham hare ze muttar veen tzarich sheela lechacham. veim haya am haaretz marin beenav shezze neder veshehu asur ufotchim lo petach mimmakom acher umattirin lo. uven shehaya talmid chacham o am haaretz goarin bahen umelammedin otan shello yinhagu minhag ze bindarim velo yihyu nodrin derech sechok vehittul: 
Vechen haomer leishto hare at alay keimmi o haomer perot ellu alay kivsar chazir sheen kan neder kemo shebbearnu. im haya haomer talmid chacham eno tzarich sheela lechacham. veim haya am haaretz tzarich sheela lechacham umarin beenav sheishto asura vesheotan happerot asurin ufotchin lo petach mimmakom acher umattirin lo nidro kede shello yinhagu kallut rosh bindarim: 
Hahefker af al pi sheeno neder hare hu kemo neder sheasur lo lachzor bo. uma hu hahefker hu sheyyomar adam nechasim ellu hefker lakkol. ben bemittaltelin ben bekarkaot. vechetzad din hahefker. kol hakkodem vezacha bo kanahu leatzmo venaasa shello. vaafillu ze shehifkir dino bo kedin kol adam im kadam vezacha bo kanahu: 
Hammafkir laaniyyim aval lo laashirim eno hefker ad sheyyafkir lakkol kishmitta. vhammafkir avadav haggedolim kanu atzman. vehakketannim kol hakkodem vehechezik bahen zacha kishar hammittaltelin: 
Hammafkir et hakkarka kol hakkodem vehechezik bah zacha. din tora afillu hifkir bifne echad hare ze hefker veniftar min hammaasrot kemo sheyyitbaer bimkomo. aval middivre sofrim eno hefker ad sheyyafkir bifne shelosha kede sheyyihye echad zoche im ratza vehashshenayim meidim. vehaomer hare ze hefker veze. hare hashsheni sefek hefker veim amar veze kemo ze o sheamar vegam ze hare hitpis hashsheni veyihye hefker vadday: 
Hammafkir et sadehu velo zacha bah adam kol shelosha yamim yachol lachzor bo. achar shelosha yamim eno yachol lachzor bo ella im ken kadam vezacha bah hare hu kezoche min hahefker ben hu ben acher: 
Haomer sade zo mufkeret leyom echad leshabbat achat lechodesh echad leshana achat leshavua echad ad shello zacha bah hu o acher yachol lachzor bo. umishshezzacha bah ben hu ben acher eno yachol lachzor bo. umippene ma yesh lo lachzor kan ad sheyyizku bah mippene shezze davar sheeno matzuy hu sheen adam mafkir lizman katzuv: 
Davar hammufkar shebba echad ushemaro vehaya mabbit bo shello yittelennu adam lo kanahu behabbata ella ad sheyyagbiho im haya mittaltelin o yachazik bakkarka kederech shekkonin hallakochot:
Mishneh Torah, Vows 3: Arbaa devarim yesh ben nedarim lishvuat bittuy. shebbishvuat bittuy en shevua chala al shevua. uvindarim yachul neder al neder. hammatpis bishvua patur uvindarim chayyav. en shevuat bittuy chala ella al divre harshut. unedarim chalot al divre mitzva kedivre harshut. shevuat bittuy chala al davar sheyyesh bo mammash veal davar sheen bo mammash. unedarim enan chalin ella al davar sheyyesh bo mammash:
Ketzad yachul neder al neder. haomer hare alay karban im achalti kikkar zo. hare alay karban im ochalenna vaachalah chayyav al kol achat veachat. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Ketzad hammatpis bindarim chayyav. shama chavero shennadar veamar vaani kemotcha betoch kede dibbur hare ze asur bema shenneesar bo chavero. shama hashshelishi ze sheamar vaani veamar vaani afillu hayu mea vechol echad mehen omer vaani betoch kede dibburo shel chavero hare kullan asurin:

Vechen haomer habbasar hazze alay asur vechazar veamar afillu achar kamma yamim vehappat hazzot kabbasar hazze hare happat nitpesa veneesra. chazar veamar udevash ze kappat hazzot veyayin ze kidvash ze afillu hen mea kullan asurin:

Hare shemmet aviv o rabbo hayyom venadar sheyyatzum oto hayyom vetzam. uleachar shanim amar hare yom ze alav keyom shemmet bo aviv o rabbo hare ze asur leechol bo kelum shehare hitpis yom ze vaasaro kayyom haasur lo. vechen kol kayyotze beellu:

Ketzad chalim hannedarim al divre mitzva kedivre harshut. haomer hare hammatztza belele happesach asura alav. hare yeshivat hassukka bechag hassukkot asura alav vahare hattefillin asurot bintila alav hare ellu asurin alav. veim achal o yashav o natal loke. vechen kol kayyotze baze. veen tzarich lomar bemi sheamar hare alay karban im ochal matztza belele happesach shehu chayyav bekarban. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Umippene ma nedarim chalim al divre mitzva ushevuot en chalot al divre mitzva. shehannishba oser atzmo al davar shennishba alav. vehannoder oser haddavar hannadur al atzmo. nimtza hannishba levattel mitzva oser atzmo uchevar atzmo mushba mehar sinay veen shevua chala al shevua. vehaoser davar ze beneder ze haddavar hu shenneesar veoto haddavar eno mushba mehar sinay:

Kesheatta mitbonen bakkatuv timtza shehaddevarim marin ken kemo shekkibbelu chachamim mippi hashshemua. shehare omer bishvuat bittuy <small>(Vayikra 5 4)</small> "lehara o lehetiv" bedivre harshut kemo shebbearnu. sheyyochal veyishte hayyom o sheyyatzum vechayyotze bahen. uvindarim hu omer <small>(Bamidbar 30 3)</small> "kechol hayyotze mippiv yaase" velo chillek ben divre mitzva ledivre harshut:

Hannoder sheyyatzum beshabbat o beyom tov chayyav latzum. shehannedarim chalim al divre mitzva kemo shebbearnu. vechen hannoder sheyyatzum yom rishon o yom shelishi kol yamav ufaga bo yom ze vahare hu yom tov o erev yom hakkippurim hare ze chayyav latzum veen tzarich lomar rosh chodesh. paga bo chanukka ufurim yiddache nidro mippene hayyamim haellu hoil veissur hatztzom bahem middivre sofrim hare hen tzerichin chizzuk veyiddache nidro mippene gezerat chachamim:

Ketzad en hannedarim chalim ella al davar sheyyesh bo mammash. haomer dibburi alecha karban eno asur milledabber immo shehaddibbur en bo mammash. vechen im amar lo dibburi asur alecha en ze keomer perotay asurin alecha o perotay karban alecha shehen asurin alav. lefichach haomer lachavero karban sheeni medabber immecha o sheeni ose immecha o sheeni mehallech immecha. o sheamar karban sheeni yashen sheeni medabber sheeni mehallech. o sheamar leishto karban sheeni meshammeshech en hanneder chal bechol ellu. vahare ze keomer dibburi vehilluchi vaasiyyati veshimmushi karban shehen devarim sheen bahen mammash:

Aval haomer yeaser pi ledibburo veyaday lemaasehen veraglay lehilluchan veenay lishnatan hare hanneder chal alehen. lefichach haomer lachavero karban pi milledabber immecha veyaday millaasot immecha veraglay millehallech immecha hare ze asur. vechen haomer hare alay karban im adabber im peloni o im lo adabber immo veavar al devaro chayyav bekarban. vechen im nadar dibbarti velo dibbarti vechayyotze bahen sheen ellu nidre issar sheanu mevaarin mishpetehem ella nidre hekdesh:

Hannoder bidvarim sheen bahem mammash vaasaran af al pi sheen hanneder chal alehem en morim lo sheyyinhog bahen hetter hoil veasar atzmo bahen uvedato shehanneder chal alehen. ella potchin lo petach mimmakom acher umattirin lo nidro af al pi shello neesar kede shello yinhagu kallut rosh bindarim:
Mishneh Torah, Vows 4:
Nidre onasin venidre shegagot venidre havay hare ellu muttarim kederech shebbearnu bishvuot. hare shehiddiruhu haannasin vehammochsin veamru lo nedor lanu shehabbasar asur alecha im yesh immecha davar shechayyav bemeches. venadar veamar hare happat vehabbasar vehayyayin asurin alay hare ze muttar bakkol veaf al pi shehosif al ma shebbikkeshu mimmennu. vechen im bikkeshu mimmennu sheyyiddor shello tehane ishto lo venadar shello tehane lo ishto uvanav veechav kullan muttarin. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Uvechol hannedarim haellu tzarich sheyyitkavven belibbo ledavar hammuttar. kegon sheyyasim belibbo sheyyihyu asurin alav oto hayyom bilvad o otah shaa vechen kayyotze baze vesomech al devarim shebbelibbo hoil vehu anus veeno yachol lehotzi bisfatav venimtza beshaa sheyyiddor lahen en piv velibbo shavin kemo shebbearnu bishvuot: 
Vechen nidre zeruzin muttarin. ketzad. kegon shehiddir chavero sheyyochal etzlo venadar ze shello yochal mippene sheeno rotze lehateriach alav. ben achal ben lo achal shenehen peturin. vechen hammocher shennadar shello yimkor chefetz ze ella besela vehallokeach nadar shello yikkachennu ella beshekel veratzu bishlosha dinarin shenehen peturin. vechen kol kayyotze baze. lefi shekkol echad mehem lo gamar belibbo velo nadar ella kede lezarez et chavero velo gamar belibbo: 
Uminnayin sheafilu arbaa mine nedarim ellu shehen muttarim sheasur lo leadam lihyot noder bahen al menat levattelan. talmud lomar <small>(Bamidbar 30 3)</small> "lo yachel devaro" lo yaase devarav chullin: 
Mi shennadar venicham al nidro hare ze nishal lechacham umattiro. vedin hetter nedarim kedin hetter shevuot sheen mattir ella chacham muvhak o shelosha hedyotot bemakom sheen chacham. uvelashon shemmattirin hashshevua mattirin hanneder. vechen shear hainyanot shepperashnu bishvuot kullan bindarim kederech shehen bishvuot: 
Veen mattirin hanneder ad sheyyachul kishvua:
